description.value: High Point is a specialty beer, wine, and spirits shop on East Hastings Street carrying more than 400 craft beer and cider selections and over 350 wines scoring 90+ points. The store hosts regular in-store producer tastings and runs a loyalty program that credits repeat purchases. Cyclists can shop online for in-store pickup or use the back loading bay for larger case orders.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 27m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 48m. Total: 6 spaces.
